weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，當你和家人潛入照亮生活空間的項目時， Joy會填滿你的家。在您交流有趣的見解時，引人入勝且友好的討論將激發人與人之間的聯繫。預計有些旅人會來拜訪，你可能會接到電話，提供令人興奮的最新消息。這是舉辦自發性聚會的絕佳機會。祝您今天愉快！
aries.horoscope_en: Joy fills your home today, Aries, as you and your family dive into projects that brighten your living space. Engaging and friendly discussions will spark connections as you exchange fascinating insights. Expect some guests to drop by, and you might receive calls with exciting updates. It's the perfect opportunity to host a spontaneous gathering. Have a wonderful day!

taurus.horoscope: 今天，與鄰居聊天可能是一個令人愉快的驚喜。你可能會發現自己與新面孔建立聯繫，同時加強與熟悉面孔的聯繫。期待分享大量有趣和寶貴的見解。金牛座，地平線上有一個你可能想參與的潛在聚會，給你一些令人興奮的期待。此外，您可能會發現自己正在交換書籍，無論是借還是借。
taurus.horoscope_en: Engaging in a chat with a neighbor could turn out to be a delightful surprise today. You may find yourself connecting with new faces while strengthening bonds with familiar ones. Expect a wealth of intriguing and valuable insights to be shared. There’s a potential gathering on the horizon that you’ll likely want to be part of, Taurus, giving you something exciting to anticipate. Additionally, you might find yourself exchanging books, whether lending or borrowing.

gemini.horoscope: 準備迎接一個愉快的驚喜吧，雙子座！您可能會收到貼心的禮物或一點現金，可能會到達您的信箱。這可能是償還貸款或感謝您為某人所做的幫助。你可能會受到啟發，向前付錢，並送禮物給別人。此外，預期一些會導致深入和豐富對話的電話。
gemini.horoscope_en: Get ready for a delightful surprise, Gemini! You might find yourself on the receiving end of a thoughtful gift or a little cash, possibly arriving in your mailbox. This could be a repayment of a loan or a token of appreciation for a favor you did for someone. You may feel inspired to pay it forward and treat someone else with a gift. Also, anticipate some phone calls that lead to deep and enriching conversations.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, expect your conversations to be friendly, enlightening, and supportive, helping you strengthen your bonds with those nearby. Your creativity and inspiration are in full swing, prompting you to invest your energy into artistic endeavors. Don't hesitate to reach out to a friend who shares your passion for creativity!

leo.horoscope_en: Leo, if you have a passion for music or the arts, today is likely to bring forth a flood of ideas and melodies that are eager to be captured. Writers, in particular, may find themselves brimming with fresh story concepts. No matter what your creative pursuits are, the universe is overflowing with inspiration. Seize the moment and dive into your projects today, or risk losing those brilliant sparks of creativity.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，期待今天的溝通旋風！你的手機和收件匣可能充斥著來自你親愛的人的訊息。你可能會發現自己正在協調聚會或社交活動。憑藉空中的樂觀和熱情，您不僅能提升自己的精神，還能激勵周圍的人。此外，您的直覺會更敏銳，讓您更清楚地感受到他人的情緒和需求。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, expect a whirlwind of communication today! Your phone and inbox will likely be buzzing with messages from those you hold dear. You might find yourself coordinating a gathering or social function. With a sense of optimism and enthusiasm in the air, you'll not only uplift your own spirits but also inspire those around you. Additionally, your intuition will be sharp, allowing you to sense the emotions and needs of others more clearly.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，期待在您的工作日舉行一次聚會，有望引發令人愉快和發人深省的討論。主題可能從哲學和靈性到藝術追求。確保溝通透明且誠實。請做好準備，因為書面交流可能與您今天的口頭對話一樣需要關注。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, expect a gathering during your workday that promises to spark delightful and thought-provoking discussions. Topics may range from philosophy and spirituality to artistic pursuits. Ensure your communication is transparent and honest. Be prepared, as written exchanges might demand just as much attention as your verbal dialogues today.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，你可能會接到來自遠方的親朋好友的來電或訊息。天蠍座，你最近一直在想這個人，所以他們的外展不應該讓你措手不及。此刻，你對周圍人的情緒和想法的敏感性得到了提高。這也可能激發一波創造力，激勵您隨著新想法在腦海中盤旋，投入到自己的項目中。祝您使用愉快！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, you might receive a call or message from a cherished friend or family member who resides far away. Scorpio, you've had this person on your mind lately, so their outreach shouldn't catch you off guard. Your sensitivity to the emotions and thoughts of those around you is heightened at the moment. This could also spark a wave of creativity, motivating you to dive into your own projects as fresh ideas swirl in your mind. Enjoy the process!

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，你的想像力可能會飛翔，為你的創意事業引發新的概念。你可能會發現自己被幻想、敘事或曲調淹沒，所以一定要在它們溜走之前把它們記下來。此外，你對周圍人的情緒和想法的敏感度也會提高。您可能會發現自己本能地向他人提供支持和理解，往往在他們表達需求之前就預測到他們的需求。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, your imagination may take flight, sparking fresh concepts for your creative endeavors. You might find yourself inundated with visions, narratives, or tunes, so be sure to jot them down before they slip away. Additionally, your sensitivity to the emotions and thoughts of those around you is heightened. You may find yourself instinctively providing support and understanding to others, often anticipating their needs before they even express them.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，當你更加適應社交圈內的人的情緒、思想和慾望時，你的親密關係將會蓬勃發展。以清晰和誠實的方式溝通很重要，但請記得在溝通時要溫和。摩羯座，社交聚會可能會特別令人愉快，因為你會吸引有趣的人分享有價值的見解。此外，在這個時候，潛入一本好書可能會獲得相當大的回報。祝您今天愉快！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, your close relationships are set to flourish as you become more attuned to the emotions, thoughts, and desires of those in your circle. It's important to communicate with clarity and honesty, but remember to be gentle in your approach. Social gatherings are likely to be particularly delightful, Capricorn, as you draw in fascinating individuals who share valuable insights. Additionally, diving into a good book could be quite rewarding at this time. Have a wonderful day!

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會散發出活力和健康。你的幸福感在你的外表中很明顯，你可能會發現自己被愉快而健康的追求所吸引，比如健身和營養飲食。不妨考慮探索一本充滿美味食譜的烹飪書，為你的餐點帶來靈感。您與他人的互動將是深情和友好的，因此，如果可以的話，請與朋友一起進行鍛煉，以幫助保持積極的勢頭。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you are likely to radiate vitality and good health. Your sense of well-being is evident in your appearance, and you may find yourself drawn to enjoyable yet healthy pursuits, like fitness and nutritious eating. Consider exploring a cookbook filled with delicious recipes to inspire your meals. Your interactions with others are set to be affectionate and friendly, so if you can, engage in workouts with friends to help maintain your positive momentum.

pisces.horoscope: 如今，隨著開放式溝通成為焦點，您的親密關係將蓬勃發展。作為一個天生直覺的雙魚座，你會發現自己與周圍人的情緒和欲望特別同步。期望加深你與親人的聯繫，特別是孩子，他們會為你的生活帶來豐富的溫暖和愛。如果你有創意的一面，現在是開始新的藝術努力的最佳時機。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, your close relationships are set to flourish as open communication takes center stage. As a naturally intuitive Pisces, you’ll find yourself particularly in sync with the emotions and desires of those around you. Expect to deepen your connections with loved ones, especially children, who will bring an abundance of warmth and affection into your life. If you have a creative side, now is the perfect time to embark on a new artistic endeavor.
